presentation_title: The Anatomy of a Good Prompt: The 3 C's
episode: 2.1 The Anatomy of a Good Prompt (The 3 C's)
learning_objectives: Identify the three essential components of an effective AI prompt.
Construct clear and specific prompts for AI tools.
Apply context and constraints to improve AI generated responses.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of AI tools like ChatGPT.

slides.title: Welcome to Prompt Engineering!
content: The Anatomy of a Good Prompt: The 3 C's
slides.narration:
Welcome to this tutorial.
We will learn about good prompts.
This episode is 'The Anatomy of a Good Prompt: The 3 C's'.
slides.image_prompt: Title slide with 'The Anatomy of a Good Prompt: The 3 C's' and 'Presented by EduPyramids'.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
content: Identify three essential components of an effective AI prompt.
Construct clear and specific prompts for AI tools.
Apply context and constraints to improve AI generated responses.
slides.narration:
You will learn many things from this tutorial.
You will identify three essential components.
These are for an effective AI prompt.
You will construct clear and specific prompts for AI tools.
You will also apply context and constraints.
This will improve AI generated responses.
slides.image_prompt: List of learning objectives on screen with icons.

slides.title: Prerequisites
content: Basic understanding of AI tools like ChatGPT.
slides.narration:
To follow this tutorial, you should have a basic understanding of AI tools.
This includes tools like ChatGPT.
This will help you understand the examples better.
slides.image_prompt: Icon representing a person using a computer with an AI chatbot interface.

slides.title: Weak Prompt, Weak Answer
content: Have you ever got a strange answer from an AI?
slides.narration:
Have you ever got a strange answer from an AI?
That's because of a weak prompt.
A weak prompt gets a weak answer.
A strong prompt gets a smart answer.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration: Person at laptop, confused expression, thought bubble above head with a question mark. AI chatbot icon with a confused face.

slides.title: The 3 C's of Good Prompts
slides.narration:
Best prompts include three ingredients.
The first ingredient is Clarity.
The second is Context.
The third ingredient is Constraints.
These are known as the 3 C's.
slides.image_prompt: Graphic showing three interconnected pillars labeled 'Clarity', 'Context', 'Constraints'.

slides.title: 1. Clarity: Be Specific!
slides.narration:
Let's start with Clarity.
You must be specific.
slides.image_prompt: Section header graphic: 'Clarity: Be Specific!' with a magnifying glass icon.

slides.title: The AI Can't Read Your Mind
content: The AI doesn't know what you're thinking.
slides.narration:
The AI can't read your mind.
Vague prompts give generic answers.
When you explain clearly, it responds better.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration: Person giving vague hand gestures to a puzzled AI robot.

slides.title: Weak Prompt Example
slides.narration:
Consider this prompt.
"Write about electric cars."
Is it vague or clear?
slides.image_prompt: On ChatGPT interface. Close-up: user typing 'Write about electric cars'.

slides.title: Pause and Think
content: What should the AI focus on?
slides.narration:
Think about it.
What should the AI focus on?
What is the target audience?
What should be the length?
slides.image_prompt: Pause animation / learner reflection moment. A thinking emoji.

slides.title: Improving Clarity
slides.narration:
Now, let's improve it.
Type the better version.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: user typing improved prompt: 'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'

slides.title: Clearer Output
slides.narration:
See the difference?
Much clearer now.
The AI understands your need.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side comparison: vague output vs improved output from AI.

slides.title: 2. Context: Give Background!
slides.narration:
Next, let's add Context.
Give it background.
slides.image_prompt: Section header graphic: 'Context: Give Background!' with a storytelling icon.

slides.title: Why Background Matters
content: Context helps the AI adopt the right perspective.
slides.narration:
Context helps the AI adopt the right perspective.
Who is the audience?
It sets the scene.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration: AI robot wearing different hats (e.g., chef hat, teacher hat) depending on the context provided.

slides.title: Prompt Without Context
content: "Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
Look at our previous prompt.
"Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits.
This is for owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
Can it be better?
slides.image_prompt: On ChatGPT interface. Close-up: user typing the previous good prompt.

slides.title: Pause and Think
content: What audience are we writing for?
slides.narration:
Think about it.
What audience are we writing for?
What is the blog's focus?
slides.image_prompt: Pause animation / learner reflection moment. A thinking emoji.

slides.title: Adding Context
slides.narration:
Let's add context.
Type this new prompt.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: user typing improved prompt with context: 'Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'

slides.title: Contextualized Output
content: The AI now understands the blog's tone.
slides.narration:
The AI now understands the blog's tone.
It tailors the response.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side: previous output vs output with context.

slides.title: 3. Constraints: Set Rules!
content: Set boundaries for the AI's output.
slides.narration:
Finally, we will discuss Constraints.
Constraints help us set the rules.
slides.image_prompt: Section header graphic: 'Constraints: Set Rules!' with a ruler or boundary icon.

slides.title: Guiding the AI
content: Tell the AI length, format, and style.
slides.narration:
Constraints are boundaries.
They shape the output.
Tell the AI the length, format, and style.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration: AI robot building blocks, with a user holding a blueprint or rulebook.

slides.title: Prompt Without Constraints
content: Here is our prompt with context.
"Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
Here is our prompt with context.
What more can we add?
slides.image_prompt: On ChatGPT interface. Close-up: user typing the prompt with context.

slides.title: Pause and Think
slides.narration:
Think about it.
What format do we need?
What style should it be?
Should there be any specific ending?
slides.image_prompt: Pause animation / learner reflection moment. A thinking emoji.

slides.title: Applying Constraints
slides.narration:
Apply the constraints.
Type the excellent prompt.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: user typing excellent prompt: 'Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city. Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone and end with a question to encourage comments.'

slides.title: Excellent Output
slides.narration:
This output is perfectly tailored.
It follows all your rules.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side: output with context vs excellent output with constraints.

slides.title: Bonus Tip: Provide a Persona
content: Tell the AI who to be.
slides.narration:
Here's a bonus tip.
Provide a Persona.
Tell the AI who to be.
This is a super-powerful trick.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration: AI robot changing into different character costumes (e.g., doctor, chef, teacher).

slides.title: Persona Example
content: "Act as an expert travel agent specializing in budget travel. Create a 5-day itinerary for a trip to Rome for a solo traveler who loves history and food."
slides.narration:
For example, "Act as an expert travel agent...".
This makes the AI's response more focused.
slides.image_prompt: On ChatGPT interface. User typing the persona prompt.

slides.title: Summary
content: Persona: Tell AI who to be.
slides.narration:
In summary, remember the 3 C's.
These are Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Also, remember to use a Persona.
slides.image_prompt: Infographic summarizing the 3 C's and Persona with icons.

slides.title: Assignment
content: Note which technique made the biggest difference.
slides.narration:
Now, let's look at an assignment.
Pick a simple topic.
Apply the learned concepts step-by-step.
Compare the results.
Note which technique made the biggest difference.
slides.image_prompt: Cartoon illustration: Person at laptop, thinking, with a checklist.
